熟悉的剧本（，徽章上，绘着四颗金星，显然，他是一名四星斗者。瞧着萧炎疑惑的视线，男子憨厚一笑，恭声道：“三少爷，我叫佩恩，是族长大人亲自任命的护卫队长，专门护卫坊市的安全，呵呵，三少爷去年过生日，佩恩还来见过…”“哦，原来是你呀，佩恩大叔啊。”萧炎眨巴了一下眼睛，虽然对这位大汉的脸没什么印象，不过他这个名字，萧炎可是熟悉的很。而且，他刚才说，是父亲亲自任命的队长，那在忠诚度方面，肯定是没问题的。虽然家族中，也分为几派，但萧炎并不在意。最多到十五岁的时候，他就有信心至少修炼到大斗师，到时候就算是几位长老一起上，他完全不惧，因此，这种派系之争，在他眼中，不过是小打小闹罢了。“在族中修炼太久，有些无聊了，出来逛逛解解闷，佩恩大叔，你去忙你的事情吧，如果有事的话，我会叫你的。”（请）熟悉的剧本（第22页）萧炎笑容温和地点点头。仅仅是一声大叔，便让佩恩脸上的笑容变得浓郁了几分，他恭敬行礼，旋即笑道：“那三少爷随意逛吧，坊市中到处都有咱们的人，有事招呼一声就行。”礼貌的点点头，萧炎拉着薰儿，钻进了人群之中。“帕里，带两个人护着三少爷，警告一下坊市中的那些金手指，谁要是敢把主意打到三少爷与薰儿小姐身上，就准备想办法看看怎么能在下辈子投个好胎吧。”望着消失的少年与少女，佩恩回头轻喝道，脸庞上的憨厚，也是在瞬间化为冷厉。“是，队长！”名叫帕里的大汉沉声点头，手一挥，带着两名队员混入了人流。“呵呵，三少爷这般耀眼的天才，待人是这般温和，简直就像是天上的太阳！”望着汇入人流的三人，佩恩忍不住感慨起来，脸上写满了忠诚。慵懒地跟在萧炎身后，薰儿不着痕迹地瞟了一眼后面的人流，淡淡的微笑道：“萧炎哥哥，那佩恩还不错。”萧炎微微颔首，轻嗯了一声。他的灵魂感知力较之常人强上许多，所以后面跟来的护卫，他也知晓得清清楚楚，收回目光，萧炎放缓速度，和身旁的少女并排而行，如青莲般淡雅的少女体香随风传来，让人心旷神怡。“八段斗之气，却能感应到三名精通隐匿的三星斗者，薰儿，你还真是深藏不露呢。”虽然萧炎知道薰儿的身份，但此刻还是得做出一副好奇探究的姿态来。薰儿闻言歪头一笑，沉默不语。凝望着少女闭口不语的模样，萧炎唇角泛起温润的笑意，手掌轻轻揉了揉少女的小脑袋，温声笑道：“不说也没关系，你迟早会告诉我的。”“萧炎哥哥可真懂薰儿，那你猜猜，薰儿今天为什么这么高兴？”薰儿快步跟了上去，笑盈盈问道。“唔……”萧炎想了想，眉头一挑，回过头来，仔细打量着眼前的少女，略有些惊讶：“你九段斗之气了？”“嘿嘿！”少女娇憨一笑，眨巴着眼睛，可爱地点点头。随后，她有些神秘地笑了笑，道：“猜对了一半，还有一半，等萧炎哥哥陪薰儿逛完街之后，薰儿再告诉你！”正当萧炎准备说些什么的时候，一道清朗的笑声，忽然从前面传来。“咦，这不是薰儿小姐么？呵呵，没想到竟然会在此处遇见，真是缘分啊。”纤细的眉头轻轻一皱，薰儿寻声而望，却是见到一堆人正涌过来，在人群中，众星拱月般的簇拥着一位衣着华贵的青年。青年年龄在十五左右，样貌颇为英俊，不过脸色却有些偏白，一双眼眸，此时正带着炽热，牢牢盯着不远处那可爱的少女，目光中，夹杂着不加掩饰的爱慕之意。

> Chapter 9 Familiar Script (Page 1)
Familiar script (, there are four gold stars painted on the badge. Obviously, he is a four-star fighter. Looking at Xiao Yan's confused gaze, the man smiled honestly and said respectfully: "Third Young Master, my name is Payne. I was personally appointed by the patriarch. The guard captain specializes in guarding the safety of Fang City. Haha, Payne came to see the third young master for his birthday last year..." "Oh, it turns out to be you, Uncle Payne." Xiao Yan blinked, although he looked at the big man's face. I have no impression, but his name is very familiar to Xiao Yan. Moreover, he just said that he is the captain appointed by his father, so there must be no problem in terms of loyalty. Although the family is divided into several factions, Xiao Yan does not care. At most, he will be fifteen years old, and he will not be afraid even if several elders join together. Therefore, in his eyes, this kind of factional fight is just a small matter. Just making a fuss. "I've been practicing in the clan for too long and I'm a little bored. Let's go out for a walk to relieve my boredom. Uncle Payne, you can go about your business. If anything happens, I will call you." (Please) Familiar script (page 22) ) Xiao Yan smiled and nodded gently. Just the word "Uncle" made the smile on Payne's face become a little brighter. He saluted respectfully, and then said with a smile: "Then, Third Young Master, please feel free to stroll around. There are our people everywhere in the city. Just say hello." Nodding politely, Xiao Yan took Xun'er and got into the crowd. "Pali, take two people to protect the third young master and warn those golden fingers in the city who dare to take action against the third young master. I and Miss Xun'er are going to try to figure out how to give birth to a good child in the next life." Looking at the disappearing boy and girl, Payne turned around and shouted softly, the simplicity on his face also turned into coldness in an instant. "Yes, team. "Chief!" The big man named Pali nodded solemnly, waved his hand, and led the two team members into the crowd. "Haha, the third young master is such a dazzling genius, he treats people so gently, he is like the sun in the sky!" Payne couldn't help but sigh with emotion, his face full of loyalty. Following Xiao Yan lazily, Xun'er glanced at the crowd behind him and said with a faint smile: "Brother Xiao Yan, that Payne is not bad. "Xiao Yan nodded slightly and hummed. His soul perception was much stronger than that of ordinary people, so he was also aware of the guards coming behind him. He withdrew his gaze. Xiao Yan slowed down and stood side by side with the girl next to him. While walking, the girl's body fragrance, as elegant as green lotus, spread in the wind, which made people feel relaxed and happy. "The Eighth Stage Dou Qi can sense three three-star fighters who are proficient in concealment. Xun'er, you are really hiding it." Although Xiao Yan knew Xun. Xun'er still had to act curious and inquisitive at this moment. He tilted his head and smiled, silently staring at the girl's silent expression. A warm smile appeared on the corners of Xiao Yan's lips, and he rubbed his hands gently. The girl's little head smiled warmly: "It doesn't matter if you don't tell me, you will tell me sooner or later." "Brother Xiao Yan really understands Xun'er, then guess why Xun'er is so happy today?" Xun'er quickly followed, smiling. Asked. "Well..." Xiao Yan thought for a while, raised his eyebrows, turned around, and looked at the girl in front of him carefully, slightly surprised: "Are you in the ninth stage of fighting?" "Hehe!" The girl smiled charmingly, blinked her eyes, and nodded cutely. Then, she smiled mysteriously and said, "Half of it is right, and the other half, I will tell you after brother Xiao Yan goes shopping with Xun'er!" Just when Xiao Yan was about to say something, a clearLang's laughter suddenly came from the front. "Hey, isn't this Miss Xun'er? Haha, I didn't expect to meet here. It's such a fate." Xun'er frowned slightly, looking for the sound, but saw a group of people rushing over. In the crowd, like stars over the moon, surrounded a richly dressed young man. The young man was around fifteen years old, with a rather handsome appearance, but his face was a bit pale. His eyes were blazing at this time, staring at the lovely girl not far away, with undisguised admiration in his eyes.
